units.translation: - 151 ⟦1⟧ cf. ⟦2⟧ 92; this is precisely a piece of the new world order, Introduction p. 9.
⟦1⟧ i.e. of the mother, as at ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧; for such plurals cf. the examples from the tragedians in P. Menge, De poet. scaen. graecorum sermone (Göttingen 1905) 25 ff.;
⟦1⟧ (210) properly means one who strikes his mother (⟦2⟧), and still has this milder meaning in Plato, Phaedo 114 A (afterwards there ⟦3⟧ of the same wrongdoers).

In this strophe and the antistrophe there are numerous assonances, partly between strophe and antistrophe (⟦1⟧ – ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ – ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧ – ⟦6⟧, ⟦7⟧ – ⟦8⟧), partly within a single verse: 155 ⟦9⟧ – ⟦10⟧, 156 ⟦11⟧, 160 ⟦12⟧, 161 ⟦13⟧; but especially, with corresponding formation in strophe and antistrophe, yet without assonance between them, 159 ⟦14⟧ and 165 ⟦15⟧. Cf. W. Kühne, De vocum sonorumque in strophicis A. canticis aequabilitate (Halle 1905) p. 5 f. The beginning repeats (intentionally) Clytemnestra's words at 135 f., with a vigorous development of the image.
of the hostile, of the public
beneath the mind, beneath the lobe
around the foot, around the head
⟦1⟧ only here (thus the blow is stronger),
⟦1⟧ = ⟦2⟧ 135, therefore ⟦3⟧. = ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧. But the last verses of the strophe add another image, that of the public torturer and scourger and his blows.

⟦1⟧ only here (on the formation Lobeck, Phryn. 539; ⟦2⟧ Ag. 1175 M, ⟦3⟧ h). Instead of the unsuitable article, with Wakefield one should write ⟦4⟧, as the verse from the Septem shows: ⟦5⟧, i.e. a shudder as (Schol.) under the blows of the executioner.
some evil cold falls upon my heart

The contrast with the younger race of gods (already in the antistrophe ⟦1⟧) now emerges even more sharply. There is parallelism and variation: strophe ⟦2⟧ and strophe ⟦3⟧ are related, likewise the two antistrophes (Weil).

⟦1⟧ is to be connected with ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧, only that ⟦7⟧, for which a spondee stands in the strophe, is probably an explanation: ⟦8⟧ Rauchenstein, ⟦9⟧ H. L. Ahrens, possible would also be ⟦10⟧, as at ⟦11⟧ ⟦12⟧.
for the newly enthroned, all-powerful seats
